about_short_description.short_description: Todos Comemos delivers pre-made ingredients that allow customers to prepare their meals in less than 10 minutes.

product.name: Integrated Sales and Logistics Service
product.description: A combined service that manages sales channels and logistics for pre-made food producers, enabling growth across multiple sales platforms.

product.name: Cold Chain Logistics
product.description: A logistics service ensuring refrigerated or frozen food products are stored and delivered under controlled temperature conditions within 24 hours.

product.name: Sales Channel Expansion
product.description: A service that helps food producers distribute their products across various sales channels including convenience stores, pharmacies, retailers, and online platforms.

product.name: Trade Marketing and Sell-in Management
product.description: Services that manage marketing activities and sales processes tailored to each sales channel for pre-made food products.

product.name: ERP Solution for Food Manufacturers
product.description: A technology platform that automates and manages end-to-end operations including sales, logistics, invoicing, and inventory for pre-made food producers.
